facts.fact: BCEAO says payment institutions are licensed in the Union under Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services, which binds Togo as a UMOA member.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA

facts.fact: BCEAO list: three payment institutions licensed in Togo at 31 August 2026, INTOUCH Togo (26 June 2025), OLLO AFRICA (4 September 2025) and SEMOA Togo (20 January 2026), of 34 in the Union.
facts.system: BCEAO Instruction n°001-01-2024 on payment services in the UMOA
